headline: Treasury settlements are the pressure point as overnight dollar funding still signals abundance
dek: A fresh move in the 2-year Treasury yield coincides with a STRAIN reading on Seiche’s board. The proposed mechanism is dated reserve pressure, but the thesis fails unless secured funding or backstop use confirms it.
